title: WiFi Terminal
summary: A computer terminal for your player
description: Open this app to allow an authenticated computer client to run commands on your X1000 over the same Wi-Fi network. Create a personal TLS identity using the supplied PC pairing tool first. Closing the app stops its session. Commands may run as root: inspect carefully. No shared private key or permanent system service is included.
changes: Public package uses a personal identity on user storage. Live command execution has been observed; forced-stop and full USB/sleep cleanup are not fully qualified.
